Warrior (Not Playable in Starter Set)

Comprehensive martial masters who have developed mastery across every armament type, from heavy armor and shield work through every blade discipline, spear, lance, and even command-level battlefield magic, Warriors are the most armor-flexible and weapon-diverse class in Essentia, capable of filling any martial role while outperforming dedicated specialists in their chosen lane at high levels.

‡ Abilities from their respective trees are summarized below. Ability Cards are released with Module and their expansions, supporting various Character Levels, and list the DIFS for any check an Ability requires. Refer pg. 6 for more on Ability Cards.

Note: Main Class baseline stats, Armament requirements and thresholds, and other Class features change depending on the Classes Tier, Path or Branch as noted in each respective Sub-Class.

Alignment: All

Favored Races:
Dwarf (Arctic) +5, Dwarf (Ash) +5, Human† +5, Neanderthal (Glaciera) +5, Omnè +5

†Human Playable with Starter Set.

Averse Races: None recorded.

Refer to Races for details on favored and averse paths and branches.

Passive Abilities:
These passive Abilities belong to the Main Class alone, granted once and active regardless of Tier, Path, or Branch; they are not re-granted, replaced, or duplicated at any Path or Branch.

Battle Stance, lasts 6 hours (must be recast every 6 hours to stay active). No mana cost for Main Class Abilities.

Tactical Mastery, Once Per Day the Warrior adapts mid-combat, gaining a bonus to Hit and Damage equal to their Grit Score until the end of the encounter.

Extra 1d6 + lvl physical damage on Critical Hits.
Once per encounter, Warriors can Flourish their weapon that lowers their target's Defense at a number equal to their Strength Score.

Warriors get +5 feet their base movement speed, once per encounter.

Warriors get +4 plus their VIGOR Score on Endurance checks.

Favorite Talent and Profession Trees
Talent Trees: Olympiad
Professions: Blacksmith, Stonesmith, Engineer, Tinker

No Cost to open talent tree. 5% rate increase on profession tiers. See Talent and Profession Bonuses: Races vs. Classes for how these bonuses work.

Features such as; Companion Pairing, buffs, and various Armaments and Accessories and their Modifiers and Enhancements modify base stats, refer to Basic Rules for more.

Warrior Tier Armaments
▸ Select to Expand Armaments Weapon Requirements (Must be readied and drawn to perform Abilities)

Weapon Styles and Hand:
◆Any (Slashing, Blunt, Piercing, or Chop), 1h or 2h, Melee, Throw, or Shoot.

Weapon Types:
◆Martial, TAW, or Energy for Nature Abilities; Magic for Spell Abilities.

Whenever Battle Stance (see Main Class Abilities above) is Active:

◆Weapon Bonus†: Crit add 1d6 + STR (Melee) or AGI (Shoot).
◆1H Melee: +1 Hit.
◆+2 and +2 to Hit and Olympiad Talents if the Battleworn Longsword is wielded.
◆Shield (Off) +1 AS, or a second 1h Weapon (Off) +1 Hit instead (dual-wield).
◆2H Melee: +1 Hit.
◆+2 and +2 to Hit and Olympiad Talents if the Titan's Greatblade is wielded.
◆Throw (e.g. spear or javelin): +1 Hit (Armorer), 0 otherwise.
◆+2 and +2 to Hit and Olympiad Talents if the Stormtip Javelin is thrown (Armorer).
◆Shoot (e.g. longbow): 0.
◆Spell: +1 rune and storm (Warlord).

†Reminder: A required weapon must be drawn to perform Abilities from any class's Tier, Path, or Branch; whether referring to the weapon Style, Type, Hand, Range or Grade.

Armor Thresholds
Grade: Versatile (Heavy through Light). Bonus: +1 AS per Grade above Light when properly fitted; +2 and +2 to AS and Olympiad Talents if Half Chain is worn.

+1 AS and +2 to Olympiad Talents when wearing Medium or Light Grade otherwise.

Paths and Branches unlock various Armaments not available for Class Tier Abilities.

A Path or Branch's Weapon Requirements include every weapon already available to the Main Class, plus any new weapons that Path or Branch unlocks. A Path or Branch's Armor Threshold also rises without an Armament Penalty, typically half a Grade step above the Tier before it.

Armament Thresholds allow the given Grade and anything lighter. If Armor that is heavier than the Warrior's Threshold is worn, Characters suffer the ensuing Penalties to the Armor's Score (see Armament Penalty, Basic Rules pg. 6).

▾ Collapse Armament

Warrior Main Class Abilities
Armaments reminder: Heavy Grade armor or lighter; Weapon Type: Martial, TAW, or Energy for Nature Drawn, Magic for Spell Drawn; Weapon Style (Martial only): Slashing, Blunt, or Piercing; 1h or 2h, Melee, Throw, or Shoot (e.g., sword, axe, mace, spear, lance, bow, TAW blade/rifle, or an elemental Energy blade). Wearing a heavier Grade brings a -5 Armament Penalty per Grade of difference.
Note: See each Classes respective Ability Card for full details; Ability Cards are released with Module and their expansions, supporting various Character Levels, and list the DIFS for any check an Ability requires. Refer pg. 6 for more on Ability Cards.

Witch (Playable in Starter Set)

Ancient practitioners of earth, moon, and brew magic who draw power from the natural world's oldest cycles, the pull of the moon, the chill of the north wind, and the bubbling of a well-crafted cauldron, Witches apply curses, potions, and elemental forces with an unpredictable mastery that feels less like a learned skill and more like a conversation with something that has always been listening.

‡ Abilities from their respective trees are summarized below. Ability Cards are released with Module and their expansions, supporting various Character Levels, and list the DIFS for any check an Ability requires. Refer pg. 6 for more on Ability Cards.

Note: Main Class baseline stats, Armament requirements and thresholds, and other Class features change depending on the Classes Tier, Path or Branch as noted in each respective Sub-Class.

Alignment: Evil

Favored Races:
Drow +5, Elf (Sylvan) +5, Dwarf (Snow) +5, Goblorc +5, Ratkin +5

None Playable with Starter Set.

Averse Races: Hawkbear -5, Neanderthal (Glaciera) -5, Omnè -5

Refer to Races for details on favored and averse paths and branches.

Passive Abilities:
These passive Abilities belong to the Main Class alone, granted once and active regardless of Tier, Path, or Branch; they are not re-granted, replaced, or duplicated at any Path or Branch.

Hexweave, lasts 6 hours (must be recast every 6 hours to stay active). No mana cost for Main Class Abilities.

Coven's Curse, Once Per Day the Witch lays a hex upon one target, dealing nature damage equal to twice their Willpower Score and reducing their Resistance until the end of the encounter.

Extra 1d6 + lvl nature damage on Critical Hits.
Once per encounter, Witches can Flourish their focus that lowers their target's Resistance at a number equal to their Intuition Score.

Witches get +5 feet their base movement speed, once per encounter.

Witches get +4 plus their KNOWLEDGE Score on Knowledge checks involving curse and brew lore.

Favorite Talent and Profession Trees
Talent Trees: Mole
Professions: Witchcrafter, Apothecary, Alchemist

No Cost to open talent tree. 5% rate increase on profession tiers. See Talent and Profession Bonuses: Races vs. Classes for how these bonuses work.

Features such as; Companion Pairing, buffs, and various Armaments and Accessories and their Modifiers and Enhancements modify base stats, refer to Basic Rules for more.

Witch Tier Armaments
▸ Select to Expand Armaments Weapon Requirements (Must be readied and drawn to perform Abilities)

Weapon Styles and Hand:
◆1h Piercing (dagger, Norwitch) or 1h/2h Magic Focus (stave or cauldron, Lunar/BrewMaster), path dependent. Lunar's Walking Stick and BrewMaster's Stirring Stave may bear a Stave Crown restricted to Wood, Ivory, Bone, or certain other reagents (see Stave Crowns, Basic Rules pg. 4); a Norwitch's dagger doubles as its Spell Drawn focus and may bear the same restricted Crown, but channels it at reduced strength (+1 and +1) next to a full Stave or wand's Crown (+2 and +2).

Weapon Types:
◆Martial (Norwitch) or Magic (Lunar, BrewMaster) for Spell Abilities. TAW and Energy Forbidden.

Whenever Hexweave (see Main Class Abilities above) is Active:

◆Weapon Bonus†: Crit add 1d6 + WILLPOWER.
◆1H Melee: 0 (daggers, staves).
◆+2 and +2 to Hit and Mole Talents if the Hexthorn Dagger is wielded (Norwitch).
◆a second Dagger (Off) +1 Hit instead (dual-wield, Norwitch), or a Reagent Pouch (Off) +1 spell potency instead (hex prep).
◆2H Melee: +1 Hit (staves).
◆+2 and +2 to spell potency and Mole Talents if the Cauldronbrew Stave is wielded (Lunar, BrewMaster).
◆Spell: +2 nature, moon, brew magic; +1 curse and hex.

†Reminder: A required weapon must be drawn to perform Abilities from any class's Tier, Path, or Branch; whether referring to the weapon Style, Type, Hand, Range or Grade.

Armor Thresholds
Grade: Half Heavy through Delicate (Half Leather, Bat Wing, Wool, Spider Silk). Bonus: +1 to all Witch spell potency in robes or ritual garments; +2 and +2 to spell potency and Mole Talents if Half Leather is worn.

+1 to spell potency and +2 to Mole Talents if wearing Medium (Bat Wing), Light (Wool), or Delicate (Spider Silk).

Paths and Branches unlock various Armaments not available for Class Tier Abilities.

A Path or Branch's Weapon Requirements include every weapon already available to the Main Class, plus any new weapons that Path or Branch unlocks. A Path or Branch's Armor Threshold also rises without an Armament Penalty, typically half a Grade step above the Tier before it.

Armament Thresholds allow the given Grade and anything lighter. If Armor that is heavier than the Witch's Threshold is worn, Characters suffer the ensuing Penalties to the Armor's Score (see Armament Penalty, Basic Rules pg. 6).

Fallen and Risen Classes

These rules are under heavy development. This is currently the full extent of the rule; more will be added over time.

Only classes bound to a Higher Power are capable of falling or rising. These are classes whose Abilities are granted by an external force, their alignment, oaths, and relationship with that power are the foundation of everything they can do.

Which Classes Can Fall or Rise

Lawful classes (Paladins, Clerics, Monks, Overseers, Avengers, etc.), bound to divine or lawful Higher Powers, may Fall.

Evil classes (Warlocks, Witches, Tyrants, Doom Knights, etc.), bound to evil or chaotic Higher Powers, may Rise.

Current Penalty

Falling or Rising characters whose alignment drifts all the way to Neutral can no longer perform or earn new Abilities from the class tree that is either lawful or evil, and they'll begin to take penalties and tests from their respective higher powers.

Stub: Full Fallen and Risen mechanics (Title weighting, class-specific tests, redemption, and transformation pacing) are not yet written. See the GM Codex for the matching GM-facing stub.
